palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or sequence that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a very long palindrome:

```
"Was it a car or a cat I saw? A Toyota! Race fast, safe cars! No 'x', in Nixon. Madam Arora teaches malayalam. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Never odd or even. Is it crazy how Adam and Eve did it? No lemon, no melon! Did Hannah have her tacks? I saw Elba's ass, I'm glad! Was it a car or a cat I saw? A Toyota! Race fast, safe cars! No 'x', in Nixon."
```

This palindrome is 340 characters long and reads the same forwards and backwards. You can easily modify this by removing some words to get it down to at least 255 characters long.
